evidence_excerpts: Consciousness is not an all-or-none property, but it is graded: to varying degrees, it should exist in most natural and artificial systems.
It should be possible to construct conscious artifacts by endowing them with a complex of high Φ.
text: Consciousness is graded rather than all-or-none and could in principle exist in infants, animals, or artificial systems when they possess complexes with sufficiently high Φ.
